description: This file provides utility functions to verify the URL resolution for the '/api/users' endpoint in a development environment. It constructs expected URLs based on organization ID context and logs them, aiding in debugging and validation during development.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the '/api/users' endpoint based on organization ID, with optional override, for development validation.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: A helper function to log a sample URL resolution for a specific organization (e.g., T0015), used for quick validation during development.
